procedure.fixture_semantics: Each fixture starts paused with 15 mm vertical clearance. A single setup iteration plus 40 bounded iterations advances 164 ms total at 4 ms/iteration. The one setup step is included in the total.
limitations: Named source collision contact-sensor wiring only.
The short gravity drop and pedestal establish discrete contact reporting; they do not prove swept-rotor contact coverage, flight safety, or hardware behavior.

smoke01.failed_at: one-step setup request before bounded drop
smoke01.diagnostic: The initial Python request path collapsed transport result and response Boolean, so the failure did not identify which was false.

transport_diagnostics.interpretation: Pause and single-step Python/CLI probes worked, including the subscribed-clock probe. The 40-step Python Node.request timed out at ~2.003 s even though the simulation reached 164 ms and recorded 27 contacts. The same bounded request through gz service returned data: true in ~0.331 s with the same 164 ms endpoint and 27 contacts. The runner therefore uses gz service subprocesses and never retries a timed-out multi-step request.

fixture_manifest.purpose: Gazebo contact sensor wiring positive controls only; no flight safety claim
